description: Twenty-four self-contained, wholly synthetic offline Shopee Shop Manager evaluation scenarios: three per coordinator and specialist role. Fixture observations and account terms apply only to the stated case; they are not universal platform rules. Requests and context are model inputs, while dimensions and checks are evaluator-only rubrics. No real shops, people, orders, credentials or live URLs are included.
